related.title: Megatron 流水線：microbatch 與空泡
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：求和與拼接正確、rank一致、所有通訊計時包含在速度比。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reduction/concatenation and ranks are correct; speedup includes all communication.
related.difference: 從完整時間表導出利用率，清楚區分此模型與含反向及optimizer的訓練排程。
related.differenceEn: Derive utilization from a complete timeline and distinguish the model from training schedules.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化層時間T=C/p+K，p為平行度、K為量測或假設的collective時間，不能忽略K。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 單卡C=16 ms；p4時collective2 ms；p8時collective3 ms，無重疊。 p4時間16/4+2=6 ms，速度比16/6=2.6667，非4倍。
p等時階段處理m個microbatch需m+p−1時槽；利用率m/(m+p−1)。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 p4、m8，每階段2 ms，無通訊延遲；只做前向。 11時槽共22 ms；利用率8/11=72.7273%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Simplified layer time T=C/p+K, where p is parallelism and K collective time. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Single-deviceC16 ms; collective2 ms atp4 and 3 ms atp8, without overlap. Atp4, time=6 ms, speedup2.6667 rather than4.

p equal stages processing m microbatches require m+p−1 slots; utilization=m/(m+p−1). All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. p4, m8, 2 ms per stage, no communication delay, forward only. 11 slots total 22 ms; utilization8/11=72.7273%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: AWQ／TinyChat：INT4群組尺度與真實模型容量
related.titleEn: AWQ/TinyChat: INT4 group scales and real storage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：求和與拼接正確、rank一致、所有通訊計時包含在速度比。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reduction/concatenation and ranks are correct; speedup includes all communication.
related.difference: 區分位元打包權重、尺度、中繼資料與執行暫存，不用參數數乘4bit當完整需求。
related.differenceEn: Separate packed weights, scales, metadata and runtime workspace rather than counting only4-bit parameters.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化層時間T=C/p+K，p為平行度、K為量測或假設的collective時間，不能忽略K。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 單卡C=16 ms；p4時collective2 ms；p8時collective3 ms，無重疊。 p4時間16/4+2=6 ms，速度比16/6=2.6667，非4倍。
每組G個4-bit權重和一個16-bit尺度，平均位元/權重=4+16/G。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 N=1048576權重、G128、對稱量化無zero-point；尺度FP16，不含檔案標頭。 容量=N×4/8+(N/128)×2=540672 bytes=528 KiB。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Simplified layer time T=C/p+K, where p is parallelism and K collective time. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Single-deviceC16 ms; collective2 ms atp4 and 3 ms atp8, without overlap. Atp4, time=6 ms, speedup2.6667 rather than4.

A group of G four-bit weights plus one 16-bit scale averages4+16/G bits/weight. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. N1048576 weights, G128, symmetric quantization without zero points; FP16 scales, excluding headers. Storage=540672 bytes=528 KiB.
